title: Petition of CSX Transportation, Inc. to the Department of Public Utilities for Authority to Acquire Property by Eminent Domain at 623 Franklin Street, Worcester, Massachusetts, pursuant to G.L. c. 160, § 83.
filings: Hearing Officer issues the following: (1) Ten Notices of Filing and Public Hearing and ten Orders of Notice; (2) cover letter to counsel for CSX Transportation, Inc. regarding publication ad posting of the Notices; (3) Hearing Officer Second Order on Consolidation; (4) Service List for the consolidated proceeding. DPU 10-101/102/103/104/105/110/127/128/129/130
Hearing Officer issues Ruling consolidating : DPU 10-101, 10-102, 10-103, 10-104, 10-105 and DPU 10-110
Hearing Officer forwards instructions and DPU procedures for circulation and publication of public notices and service on abutters
Counsel for CSX Transportation, Inc. files Petition for authority to acquire property by eminent domain at 623 Franklin Street, Worcester
